description: Using OMOPSO & MMOPSO algorithms on water distribution systems design. is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Mohamed Reyad Torkomany. The particle swarm optimization, PSO, was firstly developed by Kennedy & Eberhart (1995) to solve simple single-objective continuous optimization problems. This algorithm depends mainly on imitating the concept of swarm intelligence which is extensively found in birds flocks or fish schools. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2020. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
